declined.specs: The open items fit as roadmap rows. The design handoff is not a spec that is deleted when an item closes — it is the fidelity reference the build is measured against for as long as the app exists, so it lives in design/ rather than tasks/.
declined.policy: CLAUDE.md is short enough that mechanics and policy are still easy to tell apart, and the policy this project has is three citations into the homelab repo. A ## Standards section carries them; a second file would carry three lines.
